summary: Colliers International Group Inc. filed a Form 6-K reporting the completion of its previously announced acquisition of Ayesa Engineering S.A.U., the engineering division of Ayesa Inversiones S.L.U. The transaction closed on May 27, 2026. Terms were not disclosed in this filing. Ayesa Engineering's leadership retained significant equity under Colliers' partnership model. Alantra acted as financial advisor and Uría Menéndez as legal advisor to Colliers. The acquisition adds over 3,300 professionals, expanding Colliers' Engineering segment to 23 countries. As a closed deal, the risk-arb angle is moot; focus shifts to integration and potential earn-out performance linked to retained equity.
